title: C DAO manager rejects equal-reordered Path Sequence snapshot required accepted by canonical route-state vectors
description: native_sim rpl_routing test_canonical_route_state_vectors fails at main.c:1017: vector equal_reordered_equivalence_no_refresh expects acceptance (semantic_replay class, no deadline refresh) but C lichen_rpl_dao_manager returns reject. Rust side implements exactly this per closed bead 2auf.44.9.7.1 (equal sequence accepts only semantic equality without refreshing deadlines); canonical vectors live in test/vectors/rpl_route_state.json consumed by rust/lichen-rpl/tests/rpl_route_state_vectors.rs. Fix C DaoManager/DAO process path in lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/ to the same equal-sequence semantics; verify west build -b native_sim/native/64 -d <dir> lichen/tests/rpl_routing on the AWS workstation (baseline scratch recipe: /mnt/lichen-zephyr/work/waves-base, source /mnt/lichen-zephyr/env.sh, -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=$PWD/lichen) plus host rpl suite if present.
notes: Verified the accumulated C DAO manager now implements equal-Path-Sequence semantic equality as a candidate multiset (parent, Path Control, lifetime, E flag), so candidate wire reordering is accepted while unequal semantics are rejected and last_updated/expiry deadlines are not refreshed. No source edit was needed for this leaf, and dodag.c/lollipop paths were not touched. Validation: clean local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build succeeded after locally downgrading only the known upstream cbprintf -Wduplicated-branches warning from error; focused rpl_routing QEMU ztest passed 19/19. test_canonical_route_state_vectors passed, including equal_reordered_equivalence_no_refresh; test_equal_is_idempotent_without_refresh and sequence/expiry regressions also passed. git diff --check passed on DAO/vector consumers. Pinned native_sim was not started because local QEMU fully exercised the canonical C vector consumer.
